Table #data-table tbody must render EVERY original row in original order, one td per source.headers entry in that exact order, using unchanged source string cells via textContent; no rounding, extra columns, pagination or invented values. Render two visible SVG polylines in the SAME svg with viewBox='0 0 800 300': data-series='native_actual' and data-series='native_prediction'. Use only those source rows for their respective line, in original order. For each point t=Number(row.time_s),p=Number(row.position_m): x=40+720*t/1.5,y=260-220*p/1.8. Keep at least3 decimals. A POLYLINE uses its points attribute with space-separated x,y pairs: polyline.setAttribute('points',pairs.map(([x,y])=>x.toFixed(3)+','+y.toFixed(3)).join(' ')). NEVER set a path d attribute on a polyline: it renders nothing and yields zero SVG points. Do not chart observation rows in that native graph. Add meaningful labelled axes and a legend. Native SVG only, no libraries/CDNs. Show this exact visible text in #scope: Observation data and a separate native simulation. No physical calibration or causal equivalence is claimed. Show exact text #data-quality: Within declared thresholds. Text #endpoint-error must be 0.024574 (m); text #prediction-error must be 0.000523 (m). These are text elements, not inputs. The source and simulation have separate authority. Quality flags are not discarded and the native simulation is not a fitted physical experiment.
